source.name: IGN BD TOPO
source.definition: Height from lowest ground to highest gutter, not roof ridge. Source field hauteur; no derived or invented heights.
source.matchPolicy: Unknown OSM heights only. OSM intersection coverage>=0.80 and intersection/union>=0.60. Competing footprint with>=20% OSM coverage and height difference>2m rejected. Height must exceed retained OSM minHeight.
source.uncertainty: Source precision_altimetrique retained in metres; -1 means unspecified. Ground altitude retained as metadata only (-9999 unknown). Acquisition-method estimates/forced values rejected. Each matched footprint retains IGN cleabs reference. Geometry remains original OSM.
